clauses.title: Scope – Cover the
clauses.text: 1. Scope -  Cover the material, dimensions and sectional properties of aluminium equal leg angles for structural use and other applications.

clauses.title: Designation – Aluminium equal
clauses.text: 2. Designation - Aluminium equal leg angles sections shall be designated as ALE followed by lengths of legs and thickness of the section in mm. For example ALE 80 × 80 × 6

clauses.title: Dimensions –
clauses.text: 3. Dimensions - *Wrought aluminium and aluminium alloy bars, rods,and sections for general engineering purposes (third revision). For detailed information, refer to IS 3908  : 1986.
